Is this for me?

You belong here if...

The Profit Penthouse is for people who are serious, coachable, and ready to do the actual work. Not for people chasing shortcuts.

You're a complete beginner with no idea where to start

You've heard about trading but every time you try to learn, you end up more confused. You need a clear starting point — not more random content.

You've tried signals groups and still lost money

You followed alerts, had no idea why, and still lost. You're done outsourcing your brain. You want to actually understand what you're doing.

You know some basics but can't trade consistently

The setups are there but the emotions aren't cooperating. You need accountability, structure, and someone to be straight with you about your trading.

You want a community — not a guru

You're not looking for someone to follow. You want a space to grow with people on the same path who are honest about the real experience.

Your trading bestie
Hi, I'm Shantae.
Funded Futures Trader · Founder, The Profit Penthouse

I was introduced to trading over 10 years ago — and I'll be real, I had no idea what I was doing. No mentor, no roadmap. I bought a few courses along the way but nothing ever quite clicked.

I learned through YouTube, trial and error, and a lot of expensive lessons the hard way. I'm entirely self-taught, and that path came with mistakes and losses that cost me years of progress.

Eventually my tenacity paid off — I became a consistently profitable, funded trader in the futures market.

I'm not here to be another guru selling false hope. I'm here as someone who actually lived this hard journey and wants to be a guide. Think of me less as a mentor and more as that homegirl who figured it out first and is pulling you up with her.
